data.name: Nevile
data.gender_notes: Nevile is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'neofil', Nevile originally meant 'new friend'. This name was popularized by Sir Walter Raleigh and is now commonly used as a masculine given name in the English-speaking world. The name Nevile carries the meaning “New friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nevile usually hope their child will grow to embody new friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing new beginnings and the importance of friendship.
data.etymology: Nevile belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “New friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nevile total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: נביל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נביל מגיע מהשורש העברי 'נבל' שפירושו 'נושא מתנות לאלוהים' או 'חסד אלוהים'. הוא קשור למושג של מתנות רוחניות וברכה מאלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב קהילות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד, ויש לו קונוטציות של טוב, חסד ורוחניות.

in_greek.name: Νεβίλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Νεβίλ είναι όνομα που σχετίζεται με τη λατινική λέξη 'nebulus', που σημαίνει 'νεφώδης' ή 'ουράνιος'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια του 'φιλόθεος', δηλαδή 'αγαπημένος του Θεού'. Το όνομα έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους και έχει πνευματικές και ουρανικές συνnotations.

in_latin.name: Nevile
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nevile derivatur ex latino 'nebulus', quod significat 'nebula' vel 'coelestis'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen hoc habuit connotationes spirituales et divinas, scilicet 'amicus Dei' seu 'Dei servus'. Usus eius in Christianismo vetusto invenitur et cum pietate et devotion connectitur.

Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying a person of piety, kindness, and devotion.
